name: cancer-genomic-intelligence
description: Cancer Genomic Intelligence Platform: chat-first evidence retrieval for cancer-associated variants (research prototype).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
